svg.title: Commerce Upgrade Toolkit workflow
svg.desc: For each hop, assess the environment, plan the path, scan compatibility, analyze impact, and report findings. Confirm human approval and backups before executing dependency-ordered fixes. Validate and review the results before proceeding to the next hop. Stop and review failed gates or validation.

g.text: Detect environment / Plan upgrade path / Scan compatibility
Review targets, blockers, dependencies, and scope
Confirm backups, baseline, key handling, and guardrails
Services / Schema / Backend / API / Frontend / Module decommission
Validate chunks / Complete smoke tests / Review hop results
Proceed to the next hop only after review; stop on failed gates or validation.
